name: fizz!
description: A fizzy identity for a botanical soda label. A bouncing burst, tangerine orange, and high-impact rounded typography make a tiny can feel full of personality.
heading: outfit
rules: The burst uses alternating spoke lengths and a clear central dot.
Keep flavor information in distinct color blocks.
The exclamation point is part of the wordmark and should never be omitted.

system.concept: Playful exploded bubbles, juicy gradient fruit forms, loud can labels, and exuberant rounded lettering. Flavor becomes a bold, clear graphic system.
headline: A little fizz.
A lot of bright side.
features: Botanical combinations with a character of their own.
Useful, plainly stated ingredients without the mystery.
A small, sunny pleasure for the way your day goes.
system.layoutNote: Tangerine hero with massive playful lowercase, a sculptural fruit-and-bubble image, and blackcurrant pill controls. Flavor cards alternate grape and foam surfaces.
